project_name: Barbearia Imperial - Full-Stack Management & Booking App

image_urls.description: Luxurious barber chairs and sinks in a dimly lit salon
Grooming tools: safety razors and shaving brushes
Barber grooming a client with precision in a contemporary barbershop setting

features_implemented: Full JWT Authentication with Demo Roles (Admin, Barber, Client)
Client Profile with mandatory Hair Type (Liso, Ondulado, Cacheado, Crespo)
Intelligent Appointment Slot Calculation based on barber schedule, existing bookings, and service duration
Hospitality Flow (Daily active courtesies like Coffee, Craft Beer, Water)
Smart Cross-Selling of Products mapped to Client Hair Type with bundle discount
Mercado Pago PIX Checkout simulation + Pay at Salon option
Virtual Loyalty Stamp Card (10 completed appointments = 50% off 11th)
Admin & Barber Management Dashboard (Schedule management, Exception CRUD, Services CRUD, Products CRUD & Stock, Courtesies activation, Financial Reports)
